decisions.reason: As a product built directly on the firm's established coolant-management business and still publicly offered after two years, management is likely to continue it because prior development and market commitment are easy to justify in a growing machinery market.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's core process-media and sustainability positioning, so a large German engineering firm with in-house R&D is likely to stay committed rather than admit a mistaken launch.

Although somewhat less central than the core coolant line, the scraper belt chip conveyor remains close to the established offer and visible on the website, which makes withdrawal less attractive than persisting and attributing any weaker uptake to temporary market factors.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is still part of the firm's broadened conveyor portfolio and aligns with its automation and material-flow direction, so management would more likely keep backing it than write off the launch quickly.
